newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: INTERVIEW-Bangladesh plans over $3 billion ADP.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Bangladesh plans over $3 billion ADP.

text.p: Bangladesh's 1997/98 (July-June) Annual Development Plan is expected to require total spending of 130 billion taka ($3.02 billion), State Minister for Planning Mohiuddin Khan Alamgir said on Monday. "Alleviation of poverty, establishment of social justice and overall improvement in the standard of living of the common people are among top prioriti es in the next ADP," he told Reuters. "An amount of 130 billion taka ($3.02 billion) is likely to be alloted in the ADP starting on July 1, which is nearly 12 billion taka ($270 million) higher than in 1996/97," he said. He said Bangladesh, where half the 120 million population live below the poverty line, needed to raise gross domestic product to 8.2 percent from the present 5.7 percent in the next five years.
